description.zh:
防护包授权是否检查SLR角色。取值：

- **true**：表示检查SLR角色。
- **false**：表示不检查SLR角色。
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow Anti-DDoS Origin to check the service-linked role. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false**

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the Anti-DDoS Origin instance resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 检查防护包服务授权状态

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于查询当前阿里云账号是否已授权DDoS原生防护服务获取账号拥有的公网IP资产（例如，云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例等）信息。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the CheckGrant operation to query whether Anti-DDoS Origin is authorized to obtain information about the assets within the current Alibaba Cloud account.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp check-grant --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-slr true --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
